name: Germany Apartment Rent Benchmarks
license: Derived benchmark metadata for in-app guidance; verify upstream source terms before redistribution
description: City-specific long-term apartment-rent benchmarks for Berlin, Munich, and Hamburg. This dataset is intentionally limited to apartment rentals and excludes house rentals, temporary stays, and non-residential inventory.
preprocessing: Built a compact benchmark dataset from city rent guides already cited by NestGPT
Kept only one-bedroom apartment-style monthly rent benchmarks for supported cities
Excluded house rentals, whole-building listings, land, and non-residential inventory
Stored a small prompt-sized sample with notes and upstream source URLs per record
